annotations.text:
Tap the rings. The stroke draws across the title, the ring takes a tick, the row steps back.

This is the loop the product exists for, and today it is a control with no character attached to it.

Same screen, same data.

Left: three floating cards, three identical reason lines, a grey box with the title repeated inside it, and two competing pink buttons per card.

Right: the reason is printed once as a section rule, the spine carries a title with no artwork, and one quiet control per row.

What is NOT traded away:

44pt targets · every control named and roled · 200% Dynamic Type · reduced motion (the stroke appears in one frame, the haptic stays) · the nothing / could-not-look / still-working distinction.

The direction was overruled where it cost any of these — three typefaces cut to two, a 34pt spine raised to 44, auto-shrinking text deleted, and caps cut back to the eyebrow alone.
